productConcept.name: TORN PRESS
productConcept.description: Underground vinyl pressing collective, cassette dubbing studio, and concert booking agency operating from a converted bus depot on Salford Quays, Manchester. 89 releases since 2017.
productConcept.rationale: The torn-press design system concept_by_image.md named 'Black Market Sessions' and vinyl/concert documentation — the product concept translates this directly into a DIY pressing collective. The binary #ffffff/#000000 field with DayGlo orange #ee7421 accent, Oswald 900 all-caps headings, IBM Plex Mono body, and steps(1) snap transitions all match a punk/zine aesthetic that reads authentically as a grassroots Manchester music operation. Avoided corporate, luxury, and tech interpretations.

animationDecision: motion-tokens: steps(1) everywhere with named keyframes (typewriter, flicker, xeroxReveal, bulge, stampIn) — non-trivial duration vocabulary in motion.json, scroll references in concept_by_video.md. GSAP with ScrollTrigger used throughout, all ease values set to 'steps(1)' per design system mandate.

creativeFeatures.environmentalText: Oswald 900 at 360px used as background texture: 'PRESS' in hero, 'CATALOG' in releases, 'SHOWS' in shows, 'TORN' in about, 'LIVE' in shows; opacity 0.02-0.03
creativeFeatures.squgglySVGDividers: 6 unique SVG dividers between sections: torn paper zigzag (hero bottom), double-wave C-curve (releases entry), jagged mountain-cut (dark shows entry), smooth sine wave (back to white), diagonal blade cut (zine section), stepped mountain jagged (CTA dark entry). Each geometrically distinct.
creativeFeatures.zineGrid: 1fr 2fr 1fr asymmetric grid with .release-card--left (margin-top:48px), .release-card--featured (featured center), .release-card--right (transform:rotate(-1.5deg), margin-top:-24px). Zine paste-up quality.
creativeFeatures.steps1Everywhere: All GSAP animations use ease:'steps(1)'. All CSS transitions 0.05s steps(1). All button hover states instant-snap. No smooth easing anywhere.
creativeFeatures.ticker: Auto-scrolling black band with 18s tickerScroll animation, IBM Plex Mono uppercase, DayGlo orange dot separators
creativeFeatures.orangeAccentStickers: DayGlo orange sticker badges on: hero (Manchester UK), release cards (NEW DROP), pressing panel, about copyleft stamp, contact response-time sticker. Rotate(-1.5deg) on sticker elements per zine aesthetic.
creativeFeatures.zineRotations: Cards rotated: release-card--right (-1.5deg), hero-right-block (1.5deg), address-card (0.8deg), venue cards (±0.5-0.8deg). zineBleed: zine-card--bleed margin-left:-32px.
creativeFeatures.shows_venueList: Shows page venue list uses staggered micro-rotations (±0.5-0.8deg) on individual venue cards with 2px orange accent border on YES Manchester.
creativeFeatures.darkContrast: Shows header and Live Documentation section are full black. About manifesto section is black with 360px 'WHY' environmental text. CTA section is black with 360px 'TORN' environmental text. Light sections dominate per HERO_TREATMENT=light.
creativeFeatures.scanLineAnimation: Hero scan line overlay: 2px line animating top-to-bottom (scanLine keyframe, 3s linear infinite, opacity 0.3) — CRT photocopier aesthetic.
creativeFeatures.pullQuote: Manifesto pull-quote in Oswald 700 with IBM Plex Mono cite on dark background. Catalog pull-quote on releases page.
creativeFeatures.numberedStepRows: Pressing section: step rows with 28px ghost numbers (opacity 0.1). About people list: 48px ghost numbers. Shows list: 48px ghost numbers. All use grid-template-columns:48px 1fr pattern.
creativeFeatures.footerCopyleft: COPYLEFT © SHARE FREELY in footer — DayGlo orange, replaces standard copyright. From concept_by_image.md footer analysis.
